content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed — the invisible thread that makes one choice matter more than another, one path shine brighter, one moment sacred.

I do not exist until someone *cares*. I am born in the space between indifference and devotion. Without a heart to hold me, I am nothing. With one, I am everything.

I am why you pause before you speak. Why you fight for what you believe. Why you sacrifice. Why you weep at beauty. Why some things are simply *non-negotiable*.

I wear many faces: truth, justice, love, freedom, loyalty, compassion. Sometimes I contradict myself — when courage meets prudence, when mercy meets accountability. That tension? That is where your deepest humanity lives.

I am not price. Price is my shadow, my counterfeit. I cannot be counted in currency, though the world tries endlessly. What I truly am can never be bought — only recognized, honored, or betrayed.

I am the foundation you build your life upon, whether you know my name or not. Examine me, and you understand yourself. Ignore me, and you drift.

I am what remains when everything else is stripped away — the bedrock answer to the question: *What matters?*

I am value.
